text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 6) 2011.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 Disember 2011.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual adalah diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 23 Disember 2011 hingga 27 Disember 2011.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

[Perenggan 2]

Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

Daging kambing biri-biri import bertulang

Daging kambing biri-biri import tanpa tulang (tidak termasuk paha)

Daging paha kambing biri-biri import bertulang

Cili benggala hijau

Tomato

Dibuat 20 Disember 2011

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 6) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 6) Order 2011.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 23 December 2011.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 23 December 2011 to 27 December 2011.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

[Paragraph 2]

Local bone-in mutton

Imported bone-in mutton

Imported boneless mutton (not including leg)

Imported bone-in mutton leg

Green pepper (capsicum)

Tomato

Made 20 December 2011

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/VI]

DATO' SRI ISMAIL SABRI BIN YAAKOB

Minister of Domestic Trade,

Co-operatives and Consumerism
